scares.description: There is a sudden cut to a vampire POV shot outside alongside a string sound effect.
A man is suddenly thrown out the window in the background.
A screeching woman jumps in front of the two kids.
The woman suddenly begins to screech and bites into the boy’s neck.
A plate of iron suddenly falls from the ceiling.
There is another sudden cut to a vampire POV shot as it screeches and jumps at Edgar and Zoe.
Peter suddenly appears behind Edgar and screeches.
